sound_properties: Six fixed families chosen before candidate metadata
Immediate predecessor by stable version identity, no outcome-based fallback
Shared incumbent wheels and strong standard pip available
Balanced arm order; one scheduled invocation per arm
Common independent verification and full child-inclusive service resource receipt

findings.finding: Selection registration can be overwritten by rerunning select; refuse existing selected-inputs.json.
Acquisition must bind selected-inputs SHA and baseline inputs to registered freeze, and verify selected wheel filename name/version equals chosen identity.
Per-slot acquisition failures must remain recorded, without replacing target or losing remaining declared slots.
Recheck job hash after every operation and require certificate job_sha256 equals registered job identity before acceptance.
Timeout/parse/source guard failure must preserve partial campaign manifest and failed/unfinished slots; never retry or resample.
